evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3450629 ($100.09, online, product R, region 204) has a low second-generation model score of 0.014 with a historical fraud rate of 0.006, despite an elevated legacy risk score of 0.57.

Card C04570-K1 shows consistent history with product R (29 of 52 prior transactions), online purchases (35 of 52 transactions), and region 204 (5 transactions), with similar amounts appearing in recent transactions 3450436 ($100.09) and 3450503 ($99.96).
Holder history indicates transaction 3450629 is not new in region, product, amount, or device, and the holder has zero prior transactions in confirmed fraud cases.

Device D006670 is a generic Windows 10 Chrome desktop profile shared by 299 cards with ring ID -1; in the 7-day window around transaction 3450629, its fraud lift versus baseline is only 0.21, well below 1.0.
Prior closed case CC-1383 on card C04570-K1 involved a high model score of 0.91 on a $99.98 transaction that was confirmed legitimate by the cardholder and cleared.

case.summary: Transaction 3450629 for $100.09 on card C04570-K1 was flagged due to an elevated legacy risk score of 0.57 caused by an IP proxy flag. However, the calibrated second-generation fraud model scored the transaction at 0.014 with an expected historical fraud rate of only 0.006. The transaction aligns completely with the cardholder baseline across product type, online channel, billing region, and recurring purchase amounts, mirroring two other transactions completed earlier that evening. Furthermore, device D006670 has prior recognized history on this card and carries no association with fraud rings. The alert is confirmed to be a false alarm and closed as legitimate.
